rules.title: The articles
rules.explanation: Usa a/an davanti a nomi singolari non specifici, the davanti a riferimenti noti.

rules.title: To be e to have
rules.explanation: To be: I am, you are, she is; to have: I have, you have, she has.
rules.exampleFr: I am a student and I have a pencil.
rules.exampleIt: Sono studente e ho una matita.

rules.title: Present simple
rules.explanation: Per abitudini: I play, you play, he plays. In forma negativa do not / does not.

rules.title: Question words
rules.explanation: Who, what, when, where, why, how introducono domande.

rules.title: Present continuous
rules.explanation: Per azioni in corso si usa am/is/are + verbo -ing.

rules.title: Past simple
rules.explanation: Per eventi conclusi: played, went, saw, ate.

rules.title: Some and any
rules.explanation: Some spesso in frasi affermative, any spesso in domande e negative.

rules.title: Going to e will
rules.explanation: Going to per intenzioni; will per previsioni e decisioni spontanee.
rules.exampleFr: I am going to study tomorrow.

rules.title: Present perfect
rules.explanation: Have/has + participio per esperienze e azioni con legame al presente.

rules.title: Comparatives
rules.explanation: Aggiungi -er oppure more; superlativi con -est o most.
